back_translation: Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD has risen shining upon you.
For behold, darkness covers the earth and thick darkness the peoples; but the LORD will rise shining over you, and his glory will appear over you.
Nations will walk to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn.
Lift up your eyes and look around: they all gather and come to you; your sons will come from afar, and your daughters will be carried on the hip.
Then you will see and be radiant; your heart will pound and swell with joy, because the wealth of the sea will be brought to you, and the riches of the nations will come to you.
A multitude of camels will cover your land — young camels of Midian and Ephah; all from Sheba will come, bearing gold and frankincense and proclaiming the good news of the praises of the LORD.
All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered to you; the rams of Nebaioth will serve you; they will be offered up on my altar with acceptance, and I will adorn my glorious house with greater glory.
Who are these who fly like clouds, and like doves flying back to their nests?

Surely the islands will wait for me, with the ships of Tarshish in the lead, to bring your sons from afar, with their silver and gold, for the name of the LORD your God, and for the Holy One of Israel, for he has bestowed splendor on you.
Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you; for though I struck you in my anger, in my favor I have shown you compassion.
Your gates will stand open always; day and night they will never be shut, so that people may bring you the wealth of the nations, with their kings led in procession.
For the nation or kingdom that will not serve you will perish; those nations will be utterly destroyed.
The glory of Lebanon will come to you — the cypress, the plane, and the pine together — to beautify the place of my sanctuary, and I will honor the place of my feet.

The sons of those who oppressed you will come bowing before you; all who despised you will bow down at the soles of your feet, and they will call you the City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
Instead of being forsaken and hated, with no one passing through, I will make you an everlasting pride, a joy for all generations.
You will drink the milk of nations and nurse at the breast of kings; then you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

Instead of bronze I will bring gold, and instead of iron I will bring silver; instead of wood, bronze, and instead of stones, iron. I will appoint Peace as your overseer and Righteousness as your taskmaster.
Violence will no longer be heard in your land, nor ruin and misery within your borders; but you will call your walls Salvation and your gates Praise.
The sun will no longer be your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon shine on you; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your splendor.
Your sun will never set again, and your moon will not wane; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning will come to an end.
All your people will be righteous; they will possess the land forever. They are the branch I planted, the work of my hands, for the display of my splendor.
The smallest will become a thousand, and the least a mighty nation. I am the LORD; in its time I will accomplish it swiftly.
